author: GameTrailers
description:
Sponge Break is available now on PC via Steam. Watch the Sponge Break launch trailer for this 1-4 player co-op rafting adventure game to see gameplay and more.

In Sponge Break, players and up to three friends take on the role of sponges who've escaped the confines of the kitchen sink. Armed with nothing more than a trusty plunger-hook, a bit of wishful thinking, and proximity chat, the goal of the game is simple: navigate a very fragile raft down the world's most dangerous rapids. (Oh, and don't get wet. That's important, too.) Each sponge team must work together to keep their makeshift barge afloat while using physics and various consumable items to solve challenging puzzles, dodge environmental hazards, and avoid getting attacked by all sorts of wildlife. Simple, right?
title: Sponge Break - Official Launch Trailer

Giga Super Death, the most wicked Devil of all, was just one step away from killing God… when suddenly, he was transformed into a helpless baby. Anticipating such a crisis, Giga Super Death had been working through the night to develop the "DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER" resurrection program – and finally, it was time to activate it.
